BiblicalUsage: Once, in Paul's prayer for the Philippians: that their love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment. The word is discernment — the trained sense that tells right from wrong, good from better.
TheologicalSignificance: One verse, one prayer for discernment, and the word itself carries little weight; its weight is Paul's pairing of love with the judgment that tells good from better.
